transcript:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered - PGE-8247 - high DB & cache connection errors detected. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PGE-8247

alice: acked. I’m on it. seeing +1200 connections on pgbouncer and Redis maxclients errors in logs.

pagerduty: Incident PGE-8247 assigned to alice (Oncall). Escalation policy: DB-Primary -> DB-Senior -> Eng-Infra.

ben: any obvious deploys? Or traffic spike?

alice: no deploys, metrics show a traffic ramp from /ingest/batch endpoint starting ~5m ago. Looks like many concurrent long-running transactions.

sophia: pinged. I’ll join — might be a runaway job or a large customer import.

alice: stack checks:
```
pg_stat_activity: 850 active, many waiting on auth/lock
pgbouncer: max_client_limit reached, 503s in API
redis: rejected connections x400, KEYS latency up
```

ben: ok first mitigation — throttle batch ingress at the edge and the worker queue. Product-support, can we pause large imports? @product-support

product-support: notified top three customers with active imports. They acknowledged and paused new imports.

alice: throttling rule pushed to edge (fastly/ingress): 50% reduction for /ingest/*, rollout id = edge-674

devops-bot: edge config edge-674 deployed to region-us-west in 12s.

chris: scaling read replicas now to offload read-only queries. kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/db-readpool

alice: increasing pgbouncer max_client temporarily from 2000 -> 3000, and enabling reserve for superuser.

sophia: note: increasing too much may exhaust DB backend slots, do small increments.

alice: doing a 15-minute bump: pgbouncer set max_client_conn = 3000 (admin console)

alice: also dropping aggressive connection pool timeout for app to free stuck clients quicker: set app-side idle_timeout=30s via feature flag.

ben: can we enable readonly-fallback for non-critical routes? that reduces writer pressure.

sophia: enabled route fallback for analytics and reporting endpoints (reads only). Flag: readonly-fallback:v1

alice: Redis ops: bumped maxclients on cache nodes and cleared a couple of large keys that were blocking eviction (from customer test job). Commands run:
```
redis-cli -h cache-1 CONFIG SET maxclients 12000
redis-cli -h cache-2 CLIENT KILL TYPE normal addr 10.4.5.6:59283
```

alice: eviction lag dropped, client rejected errors falling.

pagerduty: PGE-8247 acknowledged by alice at 1725515605.

oncall-bot: autocheck scheduled in 60s; watch for pg_wal, replication lag.

alice: quick customer impact note: ~3.2% of API requests returned 503s during the peak window; major customers that hit the ingest endpoint experienced retries/timeouts. No data loss detected.

product-support: customers A, C reported delays, but not data corruption. We’ve updated status page: "Degraded performance for ingestion jobs in US-West"

sophia: plan: 1) stabilize by throttling + pgbouncer bump + read-fallback. 2) identify offending jobs and implement rate-limits per-customer. 3) follow-up: add autoscale rule for pgbouncer frontends.

ben: agree. Next: create a post-incident task to add circuit-breaker on /ingest and per-customer concurrency limits.

alice: handing off to sophia for deep DB analysis and long-term fixes. Handoff at 1725515700. I’ll stay reachable for 15m.

sophia: taking over. I’ll run explain plans on the top waiting queries and find lock sources. Also checking pgbouncer configuration and backend connection pool sizing.

chris: leaving note for infra: consider connection pooling at app tier + backpressure signal to clients (429). Filing infra ticket INFRA-1122.

alice: closing immediate incident actions: ingress throttled, imports paused, pgbouncer bump, Redis maxclients adjusted, readonly fallbacks enabled. Monitoring recovering.

sophia: ETA for root cause update: 45-60m. Will post findings and remediation plan. If any escalation, page DB-Senior.

pagerduty: PGE-8247 moved to "stabilized" at 1725515728 — monitoring continues.

oncall-bot: reminder: please add runbook steps used to the incident doc and tag with #autopager for future tuning.

alice: added quick notes to incident doc and flagged follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

product-support: added customer-facing update with estimated recovery window and contact info.

sophia: thanks team, handing back. If logs show recurring patterns, we’ll schedule a dedicated ops-review next week.

chris: thx — please include suggested SLO tweaks and autoscale thresholds in the follow-up.

alice: ack, closing thread for now. If we see new spikes, re-open or page DB-Senior.
